payload.claim: `_stack_spec_text` builds each layer's heading with that layer's own `branch` and `head` (per its docstring and the Problem section: 'one heading per layer with its spec id, branch and head'), but `test_the_join_lens_reads_the_whole_stack_once_from_the_top_layers_cell` never asserts any layer's branch or head appears in the prompt via its heading — it only checks the body text ('body TE-9', 'body TE-3 {gap}', 'body TE-7') and their order, plus the unrelated base/head range string. Replacing the heading with just `f"### {fields.spec_id}"` (dropping branch and head) keeps every existing assertion green while silently removing information the design promises the join lens for identifying which commits belong to which layer.
